en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view of a European town, showing a wide cobbled avenue lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings. On the left stands a large brick hotel with a rooftop sign reading "Hotel Kaiserhof." On the right are timber‑framed and brick houses with shopfronts and awnings. Small trees line the sidewalks and a few pedestrians are scattered along the quiet street. Printed red text at the top names the town and street; a small publisher's credit appears at the bottom.
